problem.title: Find the Minimum and Maximum Number of Nodes Between Critical Points

approaches.title: Single-pass linked-list scan
approaches.summary: Traverse the linked list once while identifying critical points and tracking the first and most recent critical indices. Update minimum adjacent distance and maximum distance from the first critical point.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduces a one-pass scan that detects local extrema and tracks the minimum and maximum distances between critical points.

revisions.commitComment: idiomatic improvements, and fix unintended double pass on first critical
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2058: idiomatic improvements, and fix unintended double pass on first critical
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Keeps the same one-pass strategy while simplifying Rust traversal and fixing the first critical point handling so adjacent critical-point distances are computed correctly.
